PaymentPage.metadataDescription: Pay with USDT. Send your payment to one of the wallet addresses below.
PaymentPage.subtitle: Send your payment in USDT to one of the wallet addresses below.
PaymentPage.qrAlt: QR code for the {network} wallet address
PaymentPage.stepErc201: Open your USDT wallet and select (ERC-20) Ethereum.
PaymentPage.stepErc202: Copy and paste the address or scan the QR code.
PaymentPage.stepErc203: Enter the amount and confirm the transaction.
PaymentPage.stepBsc1: Open your USDT wallet and select (BEP-20) Binance Smart Chain.
PaymentPage.stepBsc2: Copy and paste the address or scan the QR code.
PaymentPage.stepBsc3: Enter the amount and confirm the transaction.
PaymentPage.warning: Only send USDT on the Ethereum (ERC-20) or BSC (BEP-20) networks to these addresses. Payments sent on other networks or using other tokens may be lost permanently.

BtcPage.metadataDescription: Pay with Bitcoin (BTC). Send your payment to the wallet address below.
BtcPage.subtitle: Send your payment in BTC to the wallet address below.
BtcPage.qrAlt: QR code of the Bitcoin wallet address
BtcPage.warning: Only send BTC on the Bitcoin network to this address. Payments sent on other networks or using other tokens may be lost permanently.

BinancePage.metadataDescription: Pay with Binance. Send your payment from your Binance account to the email below.
BinancePage.subtitle: Send your payment from your Binance account to the email below.
BinancePage.qrAlt: QR code of the Binance email address
BinancePage.step1: Open your Binance app and tap Pay.
BinancePage.step2: Tap Send and choose Email as the transfer method.
BinancePage.step3: Enter the email address above and the amount, then confirm the transfer.
BinancePage.warning: Only send your payment from your Binance account to the email address above. Double-check the email before confirming; payments sent to other accounts may be lost permanently.
